title: Tronian Omegatron Triple Helix Heating Element Pack
description:
The Tronian Omegatron Triple Heating Element Pack provides a dependable heating solution for the Vapor Cup Omegatron. Although it doesn’t deliver the same high-quality vapor as the Glass Core, it is the standard choice for all other Vapor Cups, ensuring that owners get the best of both worlds. With direct contact between the heating element and your wax, it produces ample vapor for a satisfying experience. While it may require a bit more effort to clean, its performance is consistently reliable, making it a reliable secondary heating option for the Omegatron Vapor Cup.

Package Contents:
2x Tronian Omegatron Triple Helix Heating element Pack
